description: This file implements authentication services for a gym management system, including user signup, authentication, and token issuance.

methods.name: User signup(db: Session, email: str, password: str)
methods.description: Creates a new user with the default member role after verifying the email isn't already registered.

methods.name: Optional[User] authenticate(db: Session, email: str, password: str)
methods.description: Verifies user's email and password, returning the user object if authenticated.

methods.name: dict issue_tokens(user_id: int)
methods.description: Generates access and refresh tokens for the specified user ID.

ctags.name: authenticate
ctags.pattern: /^def authenticate(db: Session, email: str, password: str) -> Optional[User]:$/

ctags.name: signup
ctags.pattern: /^def signup(db: Session, email: str, password: str) -> User:$/
